name: Spaceship a5564155 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012
description: A period-14 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012 (touching neighbours), 11 to 17 cells, moving one lattice step every 14 generations (c/14). It runs the same way in the 32,768 rules from B456/S3468 to B4,5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S0,1,3,4,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,14; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells also evolve the same way on k3-003, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 32,768 rules on k2-012; 128 rules on k3-003. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 11 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
